description: Design a pure-CSS tooltip: position, colors and text, with a live hover preview and copy-paste HTML + CSS.

faqs.a: Yes — everything is done with CSS :hover, so no JavaScript is required.
The tooltip uses a data-tip attribute; you can put it on any element (buttons, links, icons) by copying the attribute and class over.
faqs.q: Can I attach it to my own button?

faqs.a: The tooltip width caps at 220px with word wrapping, so longer text wraps into multiple lines automatically.

howto: Type the tooltip text and pick a position (top, bottom, left, right).
Choose the background color, text color and corner radius.
Hover the demo button to preview it live.
Click "Copy HTML + CSS" and paste both parts into your page.
title: CSS Tooltip Generator
